preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) == n)
preconditions.description: The first line is a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10000) representing the number of strings.
Each of the next n lines contains a string of length at most 10, consisting only of lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 500000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:]) and all(line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:][::2])
preconditions.description: The line after the n strings is a single integer Q (1 ≤ Q ≤ 500000) representing the number of questions. Each question line contains two integers L and R (1 ≤ L, R ≤ n) followed by a string str (1 ≤ strlen(str) ≤ 10).
Each query string str has length between 1 and 10.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(str(sum(1 for i in range(L-1, R) if str_query in strings[i])) for L, R, str_query in queries)
postconditions.description: For each query (L, R, str_query), the output is the count of strings in the range [L, R] (1-based) that contain str_query as a substring. The results are space-separated.
